p1.title: International Mobility
p1.desc1: International mobility allows students to enrich their academic journey and experience life in an intercultural environment abroad.
p1.desc2: Through a network of prestigious academic partners in Canada, France, Italy, and many other countries, EBS students can begin their studies in Tunisia and complete them at an international partner institution.

p2.title: Technologies & Certifications
p2.desc1: The integration of emerging technologies is at the heart of our training programs. Artificial intelligence is now a cross-cutting skill integrated across all our courses.
p2.desc2: Academic pathways are complemented by internationally recognized certifications that validate operational skills in high-value fields and strengthen the employability and adaptability of our graduates.

p3.title: Economic Partners
p3.desc1: Our partnerships with economic players strengthen the link between academic training and the realities of the professional world. These collaborations promote internships, applied projects, expert interventions, and employment opportunities.
p3.desc2: By working alongside leading companies and organizations, EBS develops training programs in line with market skills and challenges.

s1.title: AI, a key skill in all our programs
s1.desc: For the 2026/2027 academic year, artificial intelligence will be integrated as a cross-cutting skill across all our programs, regardless of the chosen specialty. Students develop mastery of AI tools, uses, and related challenges so they can use it as a lever for analysis, innovation, and performance. This approach prepares graduates who can adapt to the evolution of professions and organizations in a constantly changing world.

s2.title: Integration of 150+ International Certifications in our various programs
s2.desc: EBS integrates over 150 recognized international certifications into its various training programs to strengthen academic skills through concrete professional validations. These certifications cover various fields such as management, finance, marketing, artificial intelligence, project management, cybersecurity, and digital technologies. This approach allows students to enrich their profiles, highlight their achievements, and prepare for international market standards and requirements.

s3.title: 2026-2027 Registrations Open — Special August 2026 Offers
s3.desc: Applications for the 2026-2027 academic year are now open for all our bachelor's and master's programs. Take advantage of our special July 2026 offers by pre-registering now, and prepare your academic journey in an environment focused on innovation, technology, and the skills of tomorrow. Our teaching and administrative teams are available to support you in choosing the program best suited to your academic and professional project.

about.title: EBS: The AI-Augmented University
about.desc: Espima Business School transforms its programs by integrating artificial intelligence at the heart of its training to meet the changing needs of the professional world. Our goal: to help every student build a more competitive, versatile profile aligned with the latest demands of the job market.
about.f1Desc: At EBS, every student, regardless of their field, develops mastery of the artificial intelligence tools most sought after by recruiters. Across our bachelor's and master's programs in computer science, management, finance, and marketing, AI is integrated into the heart of learning. It is not an option: it is a concrete commitment to strengthening your employability.
about.f2Desc: Beyond your degree recognized by the Tunisian State and internationally, you graduate with certifications issued by recognized organizations. Free, included in your training, and valued worldwide, they strengthen your professional profile and employability.
